title: Handley Page Halifax LV955
memorial_details: Rectangular, stained-glass panel in an oak frame, located bottom-right of an older, plain, two-light window. The panel depicts a Halifax bomber flying against a sunlit sky. The 192 Squadron badge and motto are above and below the aircraft. Two brass plaques provide the dedication and the crew names, engraved in black, upper-case letters.
inscription: Upper plaque, reported to read (though not visible on the image): DEDICATED TO THE CREW OF THE HALIFAX LV955 OF 192 SQUADRON/ WHICH CRASHED IN THE VILLAGE ON THE 4TH MARCH 1945./ Squadron badge and motto on window: 192 SQUADRON 192/ ROYAL AIR FORCE/ DARE TO DISCOVER/ Lower brass plaque: F/O E D ROBERTS / F/O R G TODD / SGT K A SUTCLIFFE / F/O W DARLINGTON RCAF † / W/O W S CLEMENTSON † / F/S R G HOLMES † / SGT J C ANDERSON † / SGT R T GRAPES †

sources.title: Steve Bond, photographs sent to the Register by WeTransfer, 9 Nov 2026
